hints: Write the partial fraction decomposition as $\dfrac{36a^2}{(2a + x)(2a - x)(5a - 2x)} = \dfrac{A}{2a + x} + \dfrac{B}{2a - x} + \dfrac{C}{5a - 2x}$.
Multiply through by the common denominator to form the identity $36a^2 = A(2a - x)(5a - 2x) + B(2a + x)(5a - 2x) + C(2a + x)(2a - x)$.
Substitute root values $x = -2a, 2a, \dfrac{5}{2}a$ to find constants $A, B, C$.
walkthrough:
Set up the partial fraction decomposition for $f(x)$ with linear factors:
$$\dfrac{36a^2}{(2a + x)(2a - x)(5a - 2x)} = \dfrac{A}{2a + x} + \dfrac{B}{2a - x} + \dfrac{C}{5a - 2x}$$

Clear the denominators by multiplying both sides by $(2a + x)(2a - x)(5a - 2x)$:
$$36a^2 = A(2a - x)(5a - 2x) + B(2a + x)(5a - 2x) + C(2a + x)(2a - x)$$

Substitute $x = -2a$ into the identity to isolate $A$:
$$36a^2 = A(2a - (-2a))(5a - 2(-2a)) + 0 + 0$$
$$36a^2 = A(4a)(5a + 4a) = A(4a)(9a) = 36a^2 A$$
$$A = \dfrac{36a^2}{36a^2} = 1$$

Substitute $x = 2a$ into the identity to isolate $B$:
$$36a^2 = 0 + B(2a + 2a)(5a - 2(2a)) + 0$$
$$36a^2 = B(4a)(5a - 4a) = B(4a)(a) = 4a^2 B$$
$$B = \dfrac{36a^2}{4a^2} = 9$$

Substitute $x = \dfrac{5}{2}a$ into the identity to isolate $C$:
$$36a^2 = 0 + 0 + C\left(2a + \dfrac{5}{2}a\right)\left(2a - \dfrac{5}{2}a\right)$$
$$36a^2 = C\left(\dfrac{9}{2}a\right)\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}a\right) = -\dfrac{9}{4}a^2 C$$
$$C = 36a^2 \times \left(-\dfrac{4}{9a^2}\right) = -16$$

Write the complete partial fraction decomposition:
$$f(x) = \dfrac{1}{2a + x} + \dfrac{9}{2a - x} - \dfrac{16}{5a - 2x}$$

ai_rubric.Partial Fractions: States form $A/(2a + x) + B/(2a - x) + C/(5a - 2x)$ (B1). Uses correct method for one coefficient (M1). Obtains $A = 1$ (A1). Obtains $B = 9$ (A1). Obtains $C = -16$ (A1).

hints: Integrate each partial fraction term individually using $\int \dfrac{1}{px + q}\,\mathrm{d}x = \dfrac{1}{p}\ln|px + q|$.
Simplify using logarithm laws $\ln(3a) = \ln 3 + \ln a$ to cancel all terms in $a$ and arrive at the form $p\ln q + r\ln s$.
walkthrough:
Integrate each term of $f(x) = \dfrac{1}{2a + x} + \dfrac{9}{2a - x} - \dfrac{16}{5a - 2x}$ with respect to $x$:
$$\int \dfrac{1}{2a + x}\,\mathrm{d}x = \ln|2a + x|$$
$$\int \dfrac{9}{2a - x}\,\mathrm{d}x = 9\left(-\ln|2a - x|\right) = -9\ln|2a - x|$$
$$\int -\dfrac{16}{5a - 2x}\,\mathrm{d}x = -16\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\ln|5a - 2x|\right) = +8\ln|5a - 2x|$$

Write the definite integral with limits from $-a$ to $a$:
$$\int_{-a}^a f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x = \left[ \ln|2a + x| - 9\ln|2a - x| + 8\ln|5a - 2x| \right]_{-a}^a$$

Evaluate at the upper limit $x = a$:
$$\text{Upper} = \ln|2a + a| - 9\ln|2a - a| + 8\ln|5a - 2a| = \ln(3a) - 9\ln(a) + 8\ln(3a)$$
Combine like terms:
$$\text{Upper} = 9\ln(3a) - 9\ln(a) = 9(\ln 3 + \ln a) - 9\ln a = 9\ln 3$$

Evaluate at the lower limit $x = -a$:
$$\text{Lower} = \ln|2a - a| - 9\ln|2a - (-a)| + 8\ln|5a - 2(-a)| = \ln(a) - 9\ln(3a) + 8\ln(7a)$$
Expand using $\ln(ka) = \ln k + \ln a$:
$$\text{Lower} = \ln a - 9(\ln 3 + \ln a) + 8(\ln 7 + \ln a)$$
$$= \ln a - 9\ln 3 - 9\ln a + 8\ln 7 + 8\ln a$$
$$= (1 - 9 + 8)\ln a - 9\ln 3 + 8\ln 7 = -9\ln 3 + 8\ln 7$$

Subtract the lower limit from the upper limit:
$$\int_{-a}^a f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x = \text{Upper} - \text{Lower}$$
$$= 9\ln 3 - (-9\ln 3 + 8\ln 7)$$
$$= 9\ln 3 + 9\ln 3 - 8\ln 7$$
$$= 18\ln 3 - 8\ln 7$$

Verify the form $p\ln q + r\ln s$:
Here $p = 18$ and $r = -8$ are integers, and $q = 3$ and $s = 7$ are prime numbers.

ai_rubric.Integrating Rational Functions: Integrates to obtain correct terms $\ln|2a+x|$, $-9\ln|2a-x|$, and $8\ln|5a-2x|$ (B1B1B1). Substitutes limits $-a$ and $a$ and cancels all terms in $a$ (M1). Obtains exact answer $18\ln 3 - 8\ln 7$ (A1).
